thread:
jen: Heads-up 10min: I'm landing a consolidation of the Optimize docs today. Moving old pages into /optimize, collapsing multiple examples into /optimize/examples, and adding a small migration guide for teams that linked the previous paths. PR shortly.

alex: 👍 what are we collapsing exactly?

jen: A few things:
- 'batching-presets', 'batching-heuristics', and 'batch-controls' -> unified under 'batching-policies'.
- 'quant-presets' and 'quant-heuristics' -> 'quant-profiles'.
- examples scattered across /examples and /guides -> single /optimize/examples.

sam: Will you add redirects for the old URLs? customers will hit 404s.

jen: Yes, planning to add redirects.yml with explicit mappings and a fallback list. Example mapping I'm adding:

```yaml
- from: /docs/batch-controls.html
  to: /optimize/batching-policies/
- from: /docs/quant-presets.html
  to: /optimize/quant-profiles/
```

priyam: Can you include a short compatibility note we can paste into release notes? One sentence per moved page.

jen: On it. I'll add docs/migration-guides/optimize-legacy.md with a table of old path -> new path + one-liner.

alex: SDK snippets? prefer Node-first this time.

jen: Good call. I'll include a compact Node example and a curl example for quick testing. Node snippet below:

```js
const { OptimizeClient } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new OptimizeClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });

(async () => {
  const policy = {
    batchingPolicy: { maxBatchMs: 25, maxTokens: 256 },
    cache: { enabled: true, ttl: 3600 },
    quantProfile: 'q8_0'
  };
  const res = await client.optimize.run({ model: 'redwood-1-medium', prompt: 'Short summary', policy });
  console.log(res.output);
})();
```

sam: Nice. Add a small note: q8_0 trades latency for slightly better generation stability vs q4_0. One line.

jen: Will do. Also adding a quick curl for infra folks:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-medium","prompt":"Summarize","policy":{"quantProfile":"q8_0"}}'
```

priyam: CI: please include a link-check step that tolerates internal redirects. We had flaky linkcheck before.

jen: Added a GitHub Actions job using lychee with --allow-redirects. snippet in PR.

```yaml
- name: Link check
  run: |
    pip install lychee-check
    lychee check ./public --allow-redirects
```

docs-bot: Reminder: add docs/CHANGELOG.md entry and apply label docs:optimize.

jen: changelog entry added and label set. PR is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987 (wip). tagging @alex @sam @priyam for review.

preview-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-4987--docs.redwood.ai/ (expires in 7 days) :rocket:

alex: preview looks good. tiny wording nit in cache section: "prefix cache" -> "prefix-based cache". sending suggestion on PR.

sam: Also flagging a small missing example for invalidating prefix caches after model-rollout. can you add a note or a one-liner command?

jen: added a short command suggestion to the examples folder: `client.cache.invalidatePrefix('summaries/')` and a note about TTLs.

priyam: LGTM pending CI. Thanks for consolidating this, should cut down support tickets.

jen: thanks all 44d merging after CI green. I'll post a short message in #general with the migration guide link.
